children: Prediction markets for elections strengthen democracy by giving voters more skin in the game, PredictIt CEO John Phillips says at the NEXTPredict summit in New York. Platforms like PredictIt, the privately held subsidiary of Aristotle Inc., serve as an "engagement booster on steroids" that will get voters even more interested in election outcomes and the political process, Phillips says. The CEO is pushing back on concerns that prediction markets for elections can deteriorate the democratic process. (dean.seal@wsj.com)
